explanation: Crocodiles and birds are the two surviving branches of the archosaurs, a group that also included the other dinosaurs and the pterosaurs. Lizards split from that line much earlier.

claims.text: Crocodilians are more closely related to birds than to lizards.
Crocodilians and birds are the two living groups of archosaurs, which also included non-bird dinosaurs and pterosaurs.
The lineage leading to lizards split from the archosaur lineage before crocodilians and birds diverged.
